description: Get the SEC Form ADV / IAPD profile for an investment-adviser firm by its CRD number (the firm_source_id / CRD returned by adv_search_firm). Returns basic firm info, registration status, SEC number, notice-filing jurisdictions, disclosure flag, Form ADV Part 2 brochure list, and direct links to the full Form ADV report PDF. Also returns `regulatory_aum`: Form ADV Part 1A Item 5.F regulatory assets under management (discretionary, non-discretionary, total, in USD), account counts and non-US-client AUM, from the SEC Division of Investment Management monthly adviser release, with its data_as_of. Present for SEC-registered advisers only (state-registered and exempt reporting advisers file no 5.F in that release; the field says so). Disciplinary narratives still live in the linked Form ADV PDF.

crd.description: Firm CRD number (a.k.a. firm_source_id), digits only. Never guess a CRD from a firm name: call adv_search_firm with the name first and use the CRD it returns.

name: adv_firm_profile
